input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor. Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee payable by us. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee", acceleration and minimum-use charges return nothing adverse: Section 9.4 lets us terminate for convenience paying only for conforming Services rendered (with refund of prepaid Fees), Section 7.1 bars unidentified minimum-use charges, Section 27.3 permits termination "without penalty", and Section 24.4 bars acceleration of Fees on our change of control. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages). The Section 2.1 take-or-pay commitment creates economic exposure but is not framed as liquidated damages or a penalty and is addressed under the minimum-commitment rule, so we do not double-flag it here. No redline required.
